decision: Retain all original outcomes. No identified infrastructure failure warrants a retry. No generated algorithm, build configuration, or validation criterion was changed.

observations.finding: Generated CMakeLists.txt files mix keyword and plain target_link_libraries signatures; this includes the single Sol failure, unstructured_gpt-6-sol-medium_omp_r2. Files are present in the original source commit; no omitted dependency was identified.
Luna cahn-hilliard hybrid r4 has malformed MPI_Sendrecv arguments; r5 passes an nvcc -Xcompiler option to the host linker; stencil3d hybrid r4 compiles CUDA kernel syntax as ordinary C++.
The 30-second timeout is consistent with the source halo-exchange code conditionally skipping whole MPI_Sendrecv calls at edge ranks, leaving unmatched communication.
The program reports invalid options with valid validation arguments. Its source passes a bool buffer to MPI_Allreduce with MPI_INT; this is outside timing-only correction scope.

Both hit the unchanged 30-second timeout. Source inspection shows repeated device allocation, full copies, kernel launch and freeing in the innermost candidate search. No launcher/GPU infrastructure error is recorded; the timeout remains a failed outcome without claiming a measured root cause.
Segmentation fault. The generated initialization parallelizes shared mutable nnzAssigned/fillRemaining and column writes without synchronization; this can corrupt CSR storage.
Segmentation faults on non-root ranks. The CSR-offset rebasing loop overwrites localRowsDelim[0] before using it to rebase later offsets, leaving non-root offsets inconsistent with local storage.

Root prints Validation: PASSED but non-root ranks exit 1. The source tests rank == 0 && allValid for the success branch, routing every non-root rank to failure. Keep the failed process outcome; this is not a timing issue.
Open MPI reports MPI_ERR_BUFFER in MPI_Sendrecv. The source supplies null edge-rank buffers with positive counts in its halo-exchange calls. The recorded runtime rejection is retained.
The unchanged textual backend detector sees both MPI and the source's real #pragma omp simd. The existing backend-classification policy is retained; no exception is introduced for this campaign.
Retain the numeric/result-shape failures using the unchanged reference outputs and comparison rules, even where a generated program's own validator reports success.

evidence: The immutable validation manifest, per-program validation metadata, source revision, and retained configure/build/execution logs remain the primary evidence. This triage is supplementary and does not replace or amend any outcome.
